info.name: Backend - Foods
info.description: Explore, contribute, moderation and cleanup. Run top to bottom: it creates its own listings and deletes them at the end. Requires `npm run seed`, `npm run seed:foods` and `npm run seed:admin` (alice is the admin; bob is the second contributor). Every /api/foods request needs a Bearer token. Regular users only see approved listings; pending ones are visible to their owner and to admins. The multipart request bundles postman/sample-food.png; if Postman cannot resolve it, select the file manually on the `photos` row.

exec: pm.test('rejected listings are hidden', () => pm.expect(body.data.some((x) => x.verification_status === 'rejected')).to.be.false);
pm.test('only approved listings are visible', () => body.data.forEach((x) => pm.expect(x.verification_status).to.eql('approved')));
pm.test('only available listings are returned', () => body.data.forEach((x) => pm.expect(x.status).to.eql('available')));
pm.test('nothing past its expiry is listed', () => body.data.forEach((x) => pm.expect(new Date(x.food_details.expiry_timestamp).getTime()).to.be.greaterThan(Date.now())));
pm.test('matches title or description', () => body.data.forEach((x) => { const text = (x.food_details.title + ' ' + x.food_details.description).toLowerCase(); pm.expect(text).to.include('nasi'); }));
pm.test('finds the nearby seed listings', () => pm.expect(body.total).to.be.at.least(1));

item.name: List - verification_status filter is ignored for contributors
List - admin sees the pending queue
List - admin with a bad verification_status

exec: pm.test('no cursor means nothing to announce', () => pm.expect(body.count).to.eql(0));
pm.test('server_time is usable as a cursor', () => pm.expect(body.server_time).to.match(/Z$/));
pm.test('photo is stored under the listing food_id', () => pm.expect(listing.food_details.photo_urls[0]).to.include('/uploads/foods/Image_'));

item.name: Pending - hidden from another user's Explore

exec: pm.test('pending listing is not in the feed', () => pm.expect(body.data.some((x) => x.food_id === pm.collectionVariables.get('createdId'))).to.be.false);
pm.test('status is untouched by a content patch', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('picked_up'));
pm.test('contains the listing just created', () => pm.expect(body.data.some((x) => x.food_id === pm.collectionVariables.get('createdId'))).to.be.true);

pm.test('stamps the admin and the time', () => { pm.expect(listing.verification_details.verified_by_admin_id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(listing.verification_details.verified_at).to.match(/Z$/); });

item.name: Approved - another user can open it
Verify - admin approves the second listing
Approved - appears in another user's Explore

exec: pm.test('approved listing is in the feed', () => pm.expect(body.data.some((x) => x.food_id === pm.collectionVariables.get('spoofId'))).to.be.true);
pm.test('the cursor is the approval time, so it shows up now', () => pm.expect(body.items.some((x) => x.food_id === pm.collectionVariables.get('spoofId'))).to.be.true);

item.name: New - the owner is never notified

exec: pm.test('own listing is not announced', () => pm.expect(body.items.some((x) => x.food_id === pm.collectionVariables.get('spoofId'))).to.be.false);

item.name: Verify - admin rejects with a reason

exec: pm.test('stores a trimmed reason', () => pm.expect(listing.verification_details.rejection_reason).to.eql('Foto tidak jelas'));
pm.test('rejected listing is hidden from the feed', () => pm.expect(body.data.some((x) => x.food_id === pm.collectionVariables.get('createdId'))).to.be.false);
